title: Guardians and Offenders: A Survey on Harmful Content Generation and Safety Mitigation of LLM
benchmark_measurement: The paper surveys studies that measure the generation and detection of harmful content, including identity-based hate speech, offensive language, and biased content targeted at groups based on protected attributes such as religion.
findings: Large Language Models are susceptible to generating harmful content, including biases and hate speech targeting religious groups. The paper notes that datasets are being constructed to better detect and mitigate such content, with some datasets like OffensiveLang specifically including religion as a target category for offensive texts.
